title: Tag todo items
goal: Items can carry a few short tags, such as "home" or "work".

acceptance_criteria.text: Items have "tags": an array, [] by default; POST /todos and PATCH /todos/:id accept tags.
Each tag is a string, trimmed, 1 to 30 characters after trimming; at most 5 tags; repeated tags are kept once, in first-seen order.
Anything else (not an array, a non-string, an empty tag, a sixth distinct tag, a tag over 30 characters) is refused with 400 and changes nothing.

context.notes: Keep node:http only; no dependencies. Count characters, not bytes. Add tests for every acceptance criterion.
